title: Entrance & Corridor
description: A long marble corridor lined in pale fluted panelling, with a black glass column and a cluster of blue ceramic discs above a pair of sculptural lounge chairs. Smoked-glass consoles sit under a lit mirror with a jagged edge, and seen from above, a cloud of glass pendants hangs over the entrance.

title: Reception
description: One open room for sitting and dining: curved sofas around low tables and a linear fireplace, a long dining table under a cloud of glass pendants, and cut-out mirrors with organic edges on the wall behind. Arched windows with sheer curtains run along the far side.

title: Stairs
description: Treads lit from beneath rise beside a smoked-glass balustrade, with planting gathered at the foot of the stair and veined stone carried up the wall.

title: Kitchen
description: White gloss and grey cabinetry with a black granite worktop and splashback. An island with three stools sits under a ribbon pendant, with glass-fronted display shelving to one side and a second island set against an abstract canvas.

title: Guest Bedroom
description: Timber panelling and a wall of open shelving with a wine fridge, a deep modular sofa around a round table, and a television over a floating console.

title: Terrace
description: Low grey sofas and lounge chairs behind a glass balustrade, with planting set against arched openings.

title: Living Room
description: Double height, with full-height glazing and crystal sphere pendants hung through the void. Curved bouclé sofas face a black marble plinth under the television, and a geometric painting is the one strong colour in the room. A coffee bar in warm wood sits at the back, beside the stair lit tread by tread.

title: Room One
description: Fluted plaster panelling the full height of one wall, a low upholstered bed, and a window seat running under the glazing. Warm neutrals with a single figurative painting as the only colour.

title: Master Suite
description: The largest scheme in the house: bedroom, dressing room and a glazed walk-in wardrobe, tied together by a sculptural wavy mirror and bouclé seating.

title: Room Two
description: A brass screen of vertical fins divides the bed from the sitting side, with a marble bench set into the opening and chevron oak running underneath.

title: Room Three
description: Quieter than the others — a crystal pendant over the bed, built-in shelving carried around the dressing table, and blue brought in only through the bedding.

title: Room Four
description: Dark grey throughout, with the desk set into a curved bay of glazing and the television wall lit in blue from behind. Two egg chairs sit between the bed and a glass wardrobe framed in black, and a carved relief runs above the headboard.

title: Gym
description: Glazed on two sides to the trees, under a slatted timber ceiling with track spots. Treadmills and a cross-trainer face the view; the free weights and benches sit back against the solid wall.

title: Room Five
description: Taupe throughout, with a black marble panel behind a channel-tufted bed and matching bench. A glass wardrobe framed in black holds lit shelving, an arched backlit mirror hangs over a floating vanity, and an upholstered window seat sits on a fluted timber base.

title: Pharaonic Master Bedroom
description: A hand-drawn hieroglyphic panel set against carved plaster relief and an arched tile screen, with a travertine tub raised on a step beside the bed. Drawn in elevation first, then modelled and rendered.

title: Master Bedroom — Shop Drawings
description: Sections through the same room at 1:20, dimensioned wall by wall, with a materials key calling out velvet paint, cladding wood, strip cladding, LED, mirror and black marble. The drawings a contractor builds the Pharaonic bedroom from.

title: The Guest Rooms
description: Ten guest rooms, designed in 3D and then built: the finishing and the furniture were carried out on site to her drawings. Each room pairs a bed against a backlit stone-textured wall between walnut panels with a sitting area of low bouclé sofas, a walnut coffee table on two spheres, a herringbone oak floor, flush walnut doors and wardrobes, a free-form backlit mirror and a tea station on a rounded walnut cabinet.

title: The Hospital Suites
description: The hotel's hospital rooms, designed in 3D: the bed set into a backlit arched walnut niche, a lit wood column and a recessed coffee niche in the joinery, a curtain on a ceiling track to screen the bed, and a sofa and coffee table so the room reads as a suite rather than a ward.

title: The Showroom
description: The renovation of an existing car showroom: two lit ceiling rings over the display floor, a mezzanine of offices carried on black columns and wrapped in a curved white band, a marble counter with client seating beneath it, glass-partitioned offices, a meeting room and the washrooms.

title: Concept Proposal
description: An earlier proposal for the hall, presented in June 2023: cars on lit turntables beneath the ceiling rings, with the 66 Motors name carried across the mezzanine front.

title: Shop Drawings
description: The architectural interior shop drawings, issued July 2023: sections through the hall and mezzanine, and the furniture, ceiling and flooring layouts.

title: The Design
description: The apartment modelled before it was built — reception, living, kitchen and bedrooms. The walkthroughs below are the same rooms, finished.

title: Kitchen Designs
description: Four studies of one handleless kitchen — grey lacquer against book-matched marble, a tall column of integrated ovens, and a breakfast bar lit from a recessed cove.

title: Master Suite
description: Bedroom, dressing and sitting area treated as one run: carved plaster relief behind the bed, a walk-in wardrobe closed in bronze glass, and a stone fireplace wall facing the seating.

title: Living Room, Boho Style
description: Warmer and more tactile than the rest of the scheme — a woven wall hanging, rattan and raw timber, a deep linen sectional, and open shelving built around the window.

title: Furniture Plan
description: The apartment set out room by room, furnished and colour-filled — the plan the rest of the scheme was drawn from.

title: Master Room
description: Brass fins run floor to ceiling behind the bed, with a mirrored dressing run opposite and a wardrobe closed in smoked glass.

title: Bedroom
description: A quieter room: a painted panel above the bed, a fluted headboard wall, and a full wardrobe run with the dressing table folded into it. Shown from above as well as at eye level.

title: Living
description: The darkest room in the scheme — a full wall of veined marble, a sage sectional, and a bar set into the joinery with a cast bust lit against the stone.

title: Second Bedroom
description: Grey upholstery and dark timber panelling, with a dressing run under a continuous light line and a wardrobe wall in bronze mirror.

title: Reception
description: The formal room: cream panelling and gold reveals, a navy velvet seating group, and a marble-topped bar opening to the kitchen beyond.

title: Floor Plan
description: The layout the second scheme works to, drawn as a setting-out plan.

title: Classic Master Room
description: Panelled walls, a cut-glass chandelier and a classical cornice, with the television set into a moulded surround facing the bed.

title: Modern Bedroom
description: The same house in a modern register — an upholstered headboard wall, a long low media run, and a glazed wardrobe lit from within.

title: Kids' Bedroom
description: Arched niches in blue and white, a drawing wall, shelving at child height, and a soft play pit under a neon line.

title: Living
description: A tall room in pale blue and cream — marble floor, gilt wall lights, and a curved stair returning to the gallery above.

title: Bathroom, Classic Style
description: Twin gilt mirrors against a violet mosaic panel, set between full-height marble and a black and gold vanity.

title: Bathrooms, Modern Style
description: Veined white marble carried across floor, wall and bath surround, with a freestanding tub and a frameless glass shower.

title: Ground Floor Plan
description: The ground floor set out with room names and furniture.

title: The Salon
description: A freelance salon interior in blush and gold: oval gold-framed mirrors hung from the ceiling between the styling stations, blush leather chairs, a backlit onyx wall behind the wash basins, lit shelving for product along both sides, and polished cream marble underfoot beneath an open dark ceiling with track lights.

title: The Shop Floor
description: A phone and accessories store: back-lit display walls in white and brass, a curved terracotta banquette wrapped around a planter, and a stone service counter under a sculptural light.

title: Pavilion Studies
description: Student work from university, modelled and rendered in Revit: a timber canopy curving over a planted court and pool, perforated screens casting pattern across the terrace, and a glazed pavilion stepped into the slope.
